text.tagline: every break your network will ever need
text.blurb: csc-007. jungle, drum and bass, big beat, electro and footwork chops for the sound recorder synths. cut by the chopshop crew on irc. 50 cd-rs, numbered. trade it, never sell it.
intro: csc-007 is our seventh release and the first one on cd-r. it is a kit of breaks, reeses, stabs and vocal chops for the sound recorder synths: jungle at 170, big beat at 130, electro and some footwork for the americans in the channel.
every chop was cut by hand in sound recorder over about four months of late nights. no samplers were harmed.
maker_note: respect due to everybody who idles in #chopshop, to the ops who keep the bots alive, and to the pirate stations we taped in 94.
we do this for free. if you see csc releases on a shareware cd for money, tell the channel.
install: insert disc. library tab shows it as CSC007_BRK.
bass, kits, vocals, stabs, pads, fx. double click a .bsp to load.
license: this is a free release. copy it, trade it, upload it to your ftp. keep the nfo with it.
never sell it. never put it on a commercial sample cd.
use the chops in your tunes, free. shout csc if you like.
diz: breaks basses chops for the sound
text.nfo_quote: the breaks belong to whoever is still dancing.
greets: everyone who seeded the ftp at 2400 baud
